name: PR Brief: the seeded cached brief renders on Overview, and a Review focus item opens its file (SPEC-03 AC-81, AC-82)
description: From the PR list open seeded PR #482 (Overview is the default tab) and confirm the brief cached by the server seed (PR_482_BRIEF in server/src/db/seed-fixtures.ts) renders: the 'PR Brief' section label, the summary, the Risk areas list with its first risk title, and the Review focus list - and that no 'Generate brief' button is shown (AC-81). Then click the first Review focus item, 'src/config.ts:12', and confirm the Files changed tab is shown (tab=diff), the URL carries that file as the target (file=src%2Fconfig.ts) and that file's card is expanded (data-open is true) (AC-82). Read-only seeded data; no model call, no chat. Casing: SectionLabel applies text-transform: uppercase and `wait --text` reads innerText, so those waits use the rendered 'PR BRIEF' / 'RISK AREAS' / 'REVIEW FOCUS' (e2e/docs/insights.md). The list defaults to the 'needs review' filter, so the 'All' tab is clicked first (a reviewed #482 is hidden otherwise). The focus-item click uses --exact on the accessible name: the first Risk area chip is also a button whose name merely contains 'src/config.ts:12' and a substring match would toggle that chip instead. The row click keeps --exact (the next-intl blob in a <script> tag can match a non-exact text locator). The page scrolls inside <main>, so the review-focus list is scrolled into view with --selector main first. Needs the seeded brief on #482: a dev DB where someone regenerated it still passes the AC-81 text checks only if the summary was kept, so use e2e:hermetic.
